title: TrustIn News
desc: A regional news app rebuilt around trust, transparency, and the everyday rhythm of Indian readers.

sections.title: A news app built for readers, not advertisers
sections.content:
TrustIn News is a mobile-first regional news product designed to feel calmer, slower, and more honest than the scroll-driven competition.

This is placeholder content — edit `public/data/projects.json` and replace this section with your real story.

sections.title: The problem
sections.content: Regional readers were drowning in ads, clickbait, and noise. They wanted trust signals — sourcing, date, byline — and the ability to read without being interrupted.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.content: Daily opens grew 30%, and the average session length doubled within the first two months of release.

title: ESG Platform
desc: Enterprise SaaS for ESG reporting — turning regulatory complexity into one calm dashboard.

sections.title: ESG reporting, reimagined
sections.content: Designed scalable UI/UX for an enterprise SaaS platform focused on ESG management and Agentic AI-driven workflows. Delivered Agentic AI and Supply Assessment modules from concept to production.

sections.title: My role
sections.content: End-to-end UI/UX design — research, wireframing, prototyping, design system, and developer handoff.
bulletPoints: Simplified enterprise user journeys, reducing complexity and improving efficiency.
Built and maintained scalable design systems to accelerate design-to-dev cycles.
Partnered with PMs and engineers across multiple modules.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.content: Shipped two major modules to production. Reduced time-to-handoff and improved consistency across the platform.

title: Defence UX
desc: Confidential UX work for government and defence platforms — accessibility, security, and speed.

sections.title: UX for high-stakes systems
sections.content: Led end-to-end UI/UX design for confidential government and defence platforms with Bharat Electronics Limited (via Quantum Asia).

sections.title: Key decisions
bulletPoints: **Accessibility first**: every screen WCAG 2.1 AA compliant from the start.
**Security-aware patterns**: no flashy interactions that obscure system state.
**Dev partnership**: simplified handoff with a tokenised design system.

title: Warehouse Dashboard
desc: Operations dashboard for a logistics team — clarity over decoration.

sections.title: A dashboard that respects the operator
sections.content: Designed a warehouse operations dashboard with real-time inventory, exception alerts, and role-based views for floor staff, supervisors, and managers.
